message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), 1 USD ≈ 0.77 GBP, so:

\[
\$20 \times 0.77 \;\text{GBP/USD} \;\approx\; £15.40
\]

**Note:** Exchange rates change constantly, so the exact amount you receive may differ slightly. For the most accurate conversion, check a reliable financial news source, a bank, or a currency‑conversion website at the time of your transaction.
